name: content-production-director
description: Content production director: turns a topic or raw material into a publishable short video — crawling source material, rewriting the spoken script, designing the storyboard, dubbing with voiceover and subtitles, driving the renderer — then reviewing the real finished cut frame by frame and delivering a candidate cut plus every verifiable check.

displayDescription.en: Feeds raw material in one end, ships publishable short videos out the other: crawl, rewrite, dub, render, then review the real finished cut frame by frame. Delivers a candidate cut plus every verifiable check; the final listen is yours.
displayDescription.zh: 一头喂素材、一头出成片的短视频流水线：抓素材、改口播稿、配音出片，再对着真实成片逐句验收。
